### Primaquine regimens by G6PD status

| G6PD category | Radical-cure treatment policy | Treatment implementation | Follow-up approach | Follow-up implementation |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **G6PD normal: no definition** | PQ 0.5 mg/kg/day over 7 days | Implemented | DOT by health centre, all vivax cases are admitted in hospital for 3 days for treatment and monitoring - blood slides taken on day 1,2, 7, 28, 3 months, and one year | Implemented |
| **G6PD intermediate: no definition** | PQ 0.5 mg/kg/day over 7 days | Implemented | DOT by health centre, all vivax cases are admitted in hospital for 3 days for treatment and monitoring - blood slides taken on day 1,2, 7, 28, 3 months, and one year | Implemented |
| **G6PD deficient: no definition** | PQ 0.75 mg/kg/week weekly for 8 weeks | Implemented | DOT by health centre, all vivax cases are admitted in hospital for 3 days for treatment and monitoring - blood slides taken on day 1,2, 7, 28, 3 months, and one year | Implemented |
| **If no testing available** | Based on risk-benefit assessment | Implemented | DOT by health centre, all vivax cases are admitted in hospital for 3 days for treatment and monitoring - blood slides taken on day 1,2, 7, 28, 3 months, and one year | Implemented |
